' Variants claim on the top
Private monday As Object
Private mondayAM As Object
Private mondayPM As Object
Private AL As Object
Private RDO As Object
Private WC As Object

Option Explicit


Function GetTaskSkillGroups(dbPath As String, ByRef taskDict As Object, ByRef taskRequiredDict As Object) As Boolean
    ' Define variables
    Dim conn As Object
    Dim rs As Object
    Dim staffDict As Object  'dicts to store info of each task

    On Error Resume Next  ' start handle errors

    ' Initialize result
    GetTaskSkillGroups = False

    ' Create objects with error checking
    Set conn = CreateObject("ADODB.Connection")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error creating database connection: " & Err.Description
        Exit Function
    End If

    Set taskDict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error creating taskDict: " & Err.Description
        Exit Function
    End If

    Set taskRequiredDict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error creating taskRequiredDict: " & Err.Description
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' Open the connection
    conn.Open "Provider=Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0;Data Source=" & dbPath
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error connecting to database: " & Err.Description & vbCrLf & _
               "Please check if Microsoft Access Database Engine is installed."
        GoTo Cleanup
    End If

    ' Create recordset
    Set rs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error creating recordset: " & Err.Description
        GoTo Cleanup
    End If

    ' Execute query
    rs.Open "SELECT t.TaskID, t.TaskName, t.RequiredPeople, p.StaffID, p.StaffName, p.SkillScore " & _
           "FROM Tasks t " & _
           "INNER JOIN peopleSkills p ON t.TaskID = p.TaskID " & _
           "ORDER BY p.TaskID, p.SkillScore DESC", conn, 1, 1

    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error executing query: " & Err.Description & vbCrLf & _
               "SQL Error Code: " & Err.Number
        GoTo Cleanup
    End If

    On Error GoTo 0  ' close error handling

    ' Process recordset
    Do While Not rs.EOF
        Dim taskID As Long
        Dim staffID As String
        Dim staffData As String

        taskID = rs.Fields("TaskID").Value
        staffID = CStr(rs.Fields("StaffID").Value)

        ' Store required people if not already stored
        If Not taskRequiredDict.Exists(taskID) Then
            taskRequiredDict.Add taskID, rs.Fields("RequiredPeople").Value
        End If

        ' Create staff data string
        staffData = rs.Fields("StaffName").Value & "|" & _
                   rs.Fields("SkillScore").Value

        ' Create new Dictionary for task if not exists
        If Not taskDict.Exists(taskID) Then
            Set staffDict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
            taskDict.Add taskID, staffDict
        End If

        ' Add or update staff data to task's staff dictionary
        If Not taskDict(taskID).Exists(staffID) Then
            taskDict(taskID).Add staffID, staffData
        Else
            taskDict(taskID)(staffID) = staffData
        End If

        rs.MoveNext
    Loop

    ' Set success flag
    GetTaskSkillGroups = True

Cleanup:
    ' Clean up objects
    If Not rs Is Nothing Then
        If rs.State = 1 Then rs.Close  ' 1 = adStateOpen
        Set rs = Nothing
    End If

    If Not conn Is Nothing Then
        If conn.State = 1 Then conn.Close  ' 1 = adStateOpen
        Set conn = Nothing
    End If
End Function


Sub ProcessRosterSheet(ws As Worksheet, M As Object, AM As Object, PM As Object, _
                      AL As Object, RDO As Object, WC As Object)
    Dim currentRow As Long
    Dim ID As String, name As String, timeStr As String
    Dim startHour As Integer
    Dim scheduleStr As String
    
    currentRow = 4  ' roster sheet start at row 4
'    Debug.Print "Processing roster sheet"
    
    Do While currentRow <= ws.UsedRange.Rows.Count
        ' check if roster sheet reach its bottom
        If Not IsEmpty(ws.Cells(currentRow, "B").Value) And _
           UCase(Trim(ws.Cells(currentRow, "B").Value)) = "BCR" Then
'            Debug.Print "Found BCR section at row " & currentRow & ". Stopping roster processing."
            Exit Sub
        End If

        ID = CStr(ws.Cells(currentRow, "A").Value)
        name = ws.Cells(currentRow, "B").Value
        timeStr = ws.Cells(currentRow, "F").Value

        If Not IsEmpty(timeStr) Then
            If IsNumeric(ID) Or Left(ID, 4) = "INAC" Or _
               InStr(1, ID, "Programmed") > 0 Then
               
                scheduleStr = name & "|" & timeStr & "|1"  ' 1 means gategourmet staff

                ' assign staff on differnt timeStrs
                Select Case UCase(Trim(timeStr))
                    Case "AL"
                        If Not AL.Exists(ID) Then
                            AL.Add ID, scheduleStr
                        End If
                    
                    Case "RDO"
                        If Not RDO.Exists(ID) Then
                            RDO.Add ID, scheduleStr
                        End If
                    
                    Case "WCOMP", "SL"
                        If Not WC.Exists(ID) Then
                            WC.Add ID, scheduleStr
                        End If
                    
                    Case Else  ' dealing with regular timeStr: eg 06:00-14:00
                        If Not M.Exists(ID) Then
                            M.Add ID, scheduleStr

                            If InStr(timeStr, "-") > 0 Then
                                startHour = CInt(Split(Split(timeStr, "-")(0), ":")(0))
                                
                                If startHour < 12 Then
                                    If Not AM.Exists(ID) Then AM.Add ID, scheduleStr
                                Else
                                    If Not PM.Exists(ID) Then PM.Add ID, scheduleStr
                                End If
                            End If
                        End If
                End Select
            End If
        End If

        currentRow = currentRow + 1
    Loop
End Sub

Sub ProcessBCRSheet(ws As Worksheet, monday As Object, mondayAM As Object, mondayPM As Object)
    Dim currentRow As Long
    Dim ID As String, name As String, timeStr As String
    Dim startHour As Integer
    Dim scheduleStr As String
    
    currentRow = 3  ' BCR sheet start at row 3
'    Debug.Print "Processing BCR sheet"
    
    Do While currentRow <= ws.UsedRange.Rows.Count
        If UCase(Trim(ws.Cells(currentRow, "A").Value)) = "END" Then
            Debug.Print "Found END at row: " & currentRow
            Exit Do
        End If
        ID = CStr(ws.Cells(currentRow, "A").Value)
        name = ws.Cells(currentRow, "B").Value
        timeStr = ws.Cells(currentRow, "F").Value  ' Monday's colum

        If Not IsEmpty(timeStr) And timeStr <> "NA" Then
            If IsNumeric(ID) Or Left(ID, 4) = "INAC" Or InStr(1, ID, "Programmed") > 0 Then
                scheduleStr = name & "|" & timeStr & "|2"  ' 2 means Bluecollar staff or other agency

                If Not monday.Exists(ID) Then
                    monday.Add ID, scheduleStr

                    If InStr(timeStr, "-") > 0 Then
                        startHour = CInt(Split(Split(timeStr, "-")(0), ":")(0))
                        
                        If startHour < 12 Then
                            If Not mondayAM.Exists(ID) Then mondayAM.Add ID, scheduleStr
                        Else
                            If Not mondayPM.Exists(ID) Then mondayPM.Add ID, scheduleStr
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        End If

        currentRow = currentRow + 1
    Loop
End Sub


Sub PrintDictionary(dict As Object)
    Dim key As Variant
    For Each key In dict.Keys
        Debug.Print key & " => " & dict(key)
    Next key
End Sub


Sub ProcessSchedule()
    ' initialise dicts of diffent pools, as in the whole day pool, AM pool and Pm pool
    Set monday = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set mondayAM = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set mondayPM = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
        ' special status dicts
    Set AL = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set RDO = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set WC = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    ' process roster sheet
    Dim wsRoster As Worksheet
    Set wsRoster = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("roster")
    Call ProcessRosterSheet(wsRoster, monday, mondayAM, mondayPM, AL, RDO, WC)

    ' process BCR sheet
    Dim wsBCR As Worksheet
    Set wsBCR = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("BCR")
    Call ProcessBCRSheet(wsBCR, monday, mondayAM, mondayPM)

    ' print results on immediate window
'    Debug.Print "=== Monday Collection ==="
'    PrintDictionary monday
'
'    Debug.Print vbNewLine & "=== Monday AM Collection ==="
'    PrintDictionary mondayAM

'    Debug.Print vbNewLine & "=== Monday PM Collection ==="
'    PrintDictionary mondayPM

'    Debug.Print vbNewLine & "=== AL Collection ==="
'    PrintDictionary AL

'    Debug.Print vbNewLine & "=== RDO Collection ==="
'    PrintDictionary RDO

'    Debug.Print vbNewLine & "=== WCOMP Collection ==="
'    PrintDictionary WC
End Sub

Sub FilterTaskStaffByAMSchedule(ByRef taskDict As Object, ByRef mondayAM As Object)
     'loop each task
    Dim taskID As Variant
    Dim staffDict As Object
    Dim staffID As Variant
    Dim staffToRemove As Collection

    For Each taskID In taskDict.Keys
        Set staffDict = taskDict(taskID)
        Set staffToRemove = New Collection

'         see if staff's in AM pool
        For Each staffID In staffDict.Keys
'             if not add it to staffToRemove dicts, to be removed
            If Not mondayAM.Exists(staffID) Then
                staffToRemove.Add staffID
            End If
        Next staffID

'         remove not-in-AM-pool staff
        Dim removeID As Variant
        For Each removeID In staffToRemove
            staffDict.Remove removeID
        Next removeID
    Next taskID
End Sub

Function AssignAMTasks(ByRef taskDict As Object, ByRef taskRequiredDict As Object, ByRef mondayAM As Object) As Object
    ' variants claim
    Dim taskSequence As Variant
    Dim assignedStaff As Object
    Dim taskAssignments As Object
    Dim taskID As Variant
    Dim staffDict As Object
    Dim staffID As Variant
    Dim requiredPeople As Long
    Dim assignedCount As Long
    Dim currentTaskAssignments As Object
    
    ' initialisation
    taskSequence = Array(26, 27, 28, 19, 18, 17, 14, 15, 16, 4, 6, 7, 8, 3, 5, 2, 1, 9, 20, 10, 13)
    Set assignedStaff = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set taskAssignments = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    ' process of assigning staff to each task
    For Each taskID In taskSequence
        requiredPeople = taskRequiredDict(taskID)
        Set staffDict = taskDict(taskID)
        Set currentTaskAssignments = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        
        assignedCount = 0
        For Each staffID In staffDict.Keys
            If Not assignedStaff.Exists(staffID) Then
                currentTaskAssignments.Add staffID, mondayAM(staffID)
                assignedStaff.Add staffID, True
                assignedCount = assignedCount + 1
                If assignedCount >= requiredPeople Then Exit For
            End If
        Next staffID
        
        If currentTaskAssignments.Count > 0 Then
            taskAssignments.Add taskID, currentTaskAssignments
        End If
    Next taskID
    
    ' put unassgined staff in the taskId 100
    Set currentTaskAssignments = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
    For Each staffID In mondayAM.Keys
        
        If Not assignedStaff.Exists(staffID) Then
            currentTaskAssignments.Add staffID, mondayAM(staffID)
        End If
    Next staffID
    
    If currentTaskAssignments.Count > 0 Then
        taskAssignments.Add "100", currentTaskAssignments
    End If
    
    Set AssignAMTasks = taskAssignments
    Set assignedStaff = Nothing
End Function

' rerurn dicts of am tasks assignments
Function TestAssignAMTasks() As Object
    Dim taskDict As Object
    Dim taskRequiredDict As Object
    Dim amAssignments As Object

    ' abtain tasks and people skills info from the database
    If GetTaskSkillGroups("C:\Users\戴尔5580\Desktop\RosterDatabase.accdb", taskDict, taskRequiredDict) Then
        ' get am staff pool
        Call ProcessSchedule

        ' filter task staff
        Call FilterTaskStaffByAMSchedule(taskDict, mondayAM)

        ' process the assignment and get the results
        Set amAssignments = AssignAMTasks(taskDict, taskRequiredDict, mondayAM)
        
        ' return the assignment results
        Set TestAssignAMTasks = amAssignments
    End If
End Function


Sub FilterTaskStaffByPMSchedule(ByRef taskDict As Object, ByRef mondayPM As Object)
    ' loop each pm tasks
    Dim taskID As Variant
    Dim staffDict As Object
    Dim staffID As Variant
    Dim staffToRemove As Collection

    For Each taskID In taskDict.Keys
        Set staffDict = taskDict(taskID)
        Set staffToRemove = New Collection

        ' see if the staff's in pm pool
        For Each staffID In staffDict.Keys
            ' if not in the pool, add it in staffToRemove
            If Not mondayPM.Exists(staffID) Then
                staffToRemove.Add staffID
            End If
        Next staffID

        ' remove the not-in-pool staff
        Dim removeID As Variant
        For Each removeID In staffToRemove
            staffDict.Remove removeID
        Next removeID
    Next taskID
End Sub

Function AssignPMTasks(ByRef taskDict As Object, ByRef taskRequiredDict As Object, ByRef mondayPM As Object) As Object
    ' variants claim
    Dim taskSequence As Variant
    Dim assignedStaff As Object
    Dim taskAssignments As Object
    Dim taskID As Variant
    Dim staffDict As Object
    Dim staffID As Variant
    Dim requiredPeople As Long
    Dim assignedCount As Long
    Dim currentTaskAssignments As Object
    
    ' initialisation
    taskSequence = Array(11, 21, 22, 25, 24, 23, 31)
    Set assignedStaff = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set taskAssignments = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    ' process of assigning the pm staff
    For Each taskID In taskSequence
        requiredPeople = taskRequiredDict(taskID)
        Set staffDict = taskDict(taskID)
        Set currentTaskAssignments = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        
        assignedCount = 0
        For Each staffID In staffDict.Keys
            If Not assignedStaff.Exists(staffID) Then
                currentTaskAssignments.Add staffID, mondayPM(staffID)
                assignedStaff.Add staffID, True
                assignedCount = assignedCount + 1
                If assignedCount >= requiredPeople Then Exit For
            End If
        Next staffID
        
        If currentTaskAssignments.Count > 0 Then
            taskAssignments.Add taskID, currentTaskAssignments
        End If
    Next taskID
    
    ' put the assigned staff under key 101
    Set currentTaskAssignments = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For Each staffID In mondayPM.Keys
        If Not assignedStaff.Exists(staffID) Then
            currentTaskAssignments.Add staffID, mondayPM(staffID)
        End If
    Next staffID
    
    If currentTaskAssignments.Count > 0 Then
        taskAssignments.Add "101", currentTaskAssignments
    End If
    
    Set AssignPMTasks = taskAssignments
    Set assignedStaff = Nothing
End Function

' return the pm assignment dict
Function TestAssignPMTasks() As Object
    Dim taskDict As Object
    Dim taskRequiredDict As Object
    Dim pmAssignments As Object

    ' obtain tasks and people skills info
    If GetTaskSkillGroups("C:\Users\戴尔5580\Desktop\RosterDatabase.accdb", taskDict, taskRequiredDict) Then
        ' get the pm pool
        Call ProcessSchedule

        ' filter pm task staff
        Call FilterTaskStaffByPMSchedule(taskDict, mondayPM)

        ' process the asssignment and get the results
        Set pmAssignments = AssignPMTasks(taskDict, taskRequiredDict, mondayPM)
        
        ' return the assignmen results
        Set TestAssignPMTasks = pmAssignments
    End If
End Function

' prints to check the assignments
Sub UseTaskAssignments()
    Dim amResults As Object
    Dim pmResults As Object

    Set amResults = TestAssignAMTasks()
    Set pmResults = TestAssignPMTasks()

    ' AM Assignments
    Debug.Print "=== AM Assignments ==="
    Dim taskID As Variant
    For Each taskID In amResults.Keys
        If taskID <> "100" Then  ' regular tasks
            Debug.Print "Task " & taskID
            Dim staffID As Variant
            For Each staffID In amResults(taskID).Keys
                Debug.Print "  Staff " & staffID & ": " & amResults(taskID)(staffID)
            Next staffID
        End If
    Next taskID

    ' unassigned AM staff
    If amResults.Exists("100") Then
        Debug.Print "=======Unassigned AM Staff:"
        For Each staffID In amResults("100").Keys
            Debug.Print "  Staff " & staffID & ": " & amResults("100")(staffID)
        Next staffID
    End If

    ' PM Assignments
    Debug.Print vbNewLine & "=== PM Assignments ==="
    For Each taskID In pmResults.Keys
        If taskID <> "101" Then  ' regular tasks
            Debug.Print "Task " & taskID
            For Each staffID In pmResults(taskID).Keys
                Debug.Print "  Staff " & staffID & ": " & pmResults(taskID)(staffID)
            Next staffID
        End If
    Next taskID

    ' unassigned PM staff
    If pmResults.Exists("101") Then
        Debug.Print "==========Unassigned PM Staff:"
        For Each staffID In pmResults("101").Keys
            Debug.Print "  Staff " & staffID & ": " & pmResults("101")(staffID)
        Next staffID
    End If
End Sub

Sub WritePMAssignments(ws As Worksheet, pmResults As Object)
    ' variants claim
    Dim taskID As Variant
    Dim staffDict As Object
    Dim staffID As Variant
    Dim staffData As Variant
    Dim sourceColor As Long
    Dim staffCount As Long
    
    On Error Resume Next  ' satrt the error handling
    
    ' for loop each task
    For Each taskID In pmResults.Keys
        ' skip unassigned staff(taskID 101)
        If taskID <> "101" Then
            Set staffDict = pmResults(taskID)
            staffCount = 0
            
            ' for loop all the staff in the task
            For Each staffID In staffDict.Keys
                ' split the staff data
                staffData = Split(staffDict(staffID), "|")
                
                ' set color for the cell to tell the difference of staff
                If staffData(2) = "1" Then
                    sourceColor = RGB(217, 217, 217)  ' Roster
                Else
                    sourceColor = RGB(255, 242, 204)  ' BCR
                End If
                
                ' put people in the right section of the sheet depending on the taskid
                Select Case CLng(taskID)
                    Case 11
                        ' [PM admin]
                        ws.Range("B" & (34 + staffCount)).Value = staffID
                        ws.Range("B" & (34 + staffCount)).Interior.Color = sourceColor
                        ws.Range("C" & (34 + staffCount)).Value = staffData(0)  ' name
                        ws.Range("D" & (34 + staffCount)).Value = staffData(1)  ' time
                        
                    Case 21
                        ' [shift leader]
                        Select Case staffCount
                            Case 0
                                ws.Range("L3").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("L3").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("M3").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("N3").Value = staffData(1)
                            Case 1
                                ws.Range("L7").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("L7").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("M7").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("N7").Value = staffData(1)
                        End Select
                        
                    Case 22
                        ' Task 22 [Prep UA3 AA HA SB]
                        Select Case staffCount
                            Case 0
                                ws.Range("L4").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("L4").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("M4").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("N4").Value = staffData(1)
                            Case 1
                                ws.Range("L5").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("L5").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("M5").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("N5").Value = staffData(1)
                        End Select
                        
                    Case 25
                        ' Task 25 (L24-L25) [HALAL KITCHEN]
                        Select Case staffCount
                            Case 0
                                ws.Range("L21").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("L21").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("M21").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("N21").Value = staffData(1)
                            Case 1
                                ws.Range("L22").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("L22").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("M22").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("N22").Value = staffData(1)
                        End Select
                        
                    Case 24
                        ' Task 24 (L17-L21) [SPML]
                        If staffCount < 5 Then
                            ws.Range("L" & (15 + staffCount)).Value = staffID
                            ws.Range("L" & (15 + staffCount)).Interior.Color = sourceColor
                            ws.Range("M" & (15 + staffCount)).Value = staffData(0)
                            ws.Range("N" & (15 + staffCount)).Value = staffData(1)
                        End If
                        
                    Case 23
                        ' Task 23 (L8-L14) [SW]
                        If staffCount < 7 Then
                            ws.Range("L" & (8 + staffCount)).Value = staffID
                            ws.Range("L" & (8 + staffCount)).Interior.Color = sourceColor
                            ws.Range("M" & (8 + staffCount)).Value = staffData(0)
                            ws.Range("N" & (8 + staffCount)).Value = staffData(1)
                        End If
                    Case 31
                        ' Task 31 [TT PREP]
                        Select Case staffCount
                            Case 0
                                ws.Range("L26").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("L26").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("M26").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("N26").Value = staffData(1)
                            Case 1
                                ws.Range("L27").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("L27").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("M27").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("N27").Value = staffData(1)
                        End Select
                End Select
                
                staffCount = staffCount + 1
            Next staffID
        End If
    Next taskID
    
    ' unassigned staff
    If pmResults.Exists("101") Then
        ' add the title for Unassigned Staff
        ws.Range("M32").Value = "Unassigned Staff"
        ws.Range("M32").Interior.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)  ' red background
        
        ' obtain dict of unassined staff
        Set staffDict = pmResults("101")
        staffCount = 0
        
        ' loop unassined staff
        For Each staffID In staffDict.Keys
            ' split data of unassigned staff
            staffData = Split(staffDict(staffID), "|")
            
            ' color to differentiate the staff
            If staffData(2) = "1" Then
                sourceColor = RGB(217, 217, 217)  ' Roster
            Else
                sourceColor = RGB(255, 242, 204)  ' BCR
            End If
            
            ' 从L28开始填写未分配员工
            ws.Range("L" & (33 + staffCount)).Value = staffID
            ws.Range("L" & (33 + staffCount)).Interior.Color = sourceColor
            ws.Range("M" & (33 + staffCount)).Value = staffData(0)  ' name
            ws.Range("N" & (33 + staffCount)).Value = staffData(1)  ' time
            
            staffCount = staffCount + 1
        Next staffID
    End If
    
    On Error GoTo 0  ' close error handling
End Sub

Sub WriteAMAssignments(ws As Worksheet, amResults As Object)
    ' variant claim
    Dim taskID As Variant
    Dim staffDict As Object
    Dim staffID As Variant
    Dim staffData As Variant
    Dim sourceColor As Long
    Dim staffCount As Long
    
    On Error Resume Next  ' start error handling

    
    ' loop each task
    For Each taskID In amResults.Keys
        ' skip the unassigned staff
        If taskID <> "100" Then
            Set staffDict = amResults(taskID)
            staffCount = 0
            
            ' loop the staff
            For Each staffID In staffDict.Keys
                ' split the info
                staffData = Split(staffDict(staffID), "|")
                
                ' color to differentiate the staff
                If staffData(2) = "1" Then
                    sourceColor = RGB(217, 217, 217)  ' Roster
                Else
                    sourceColor = RGB(255, 242, 204)  ' BCR
                End If
                
                ' put people in the right section of the sheet depending on the taskid
                Select Case CLng(taskID)
                    Case 26
                        ws.Range("B26").Value = staffID
                        ws.Range("B26").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                        ws.Range("C26").Value = staffData(0)  ' name
                        ws.Range("D26").Value = staffData(1)  ' time
                        
                    Case 27
                        ws.Range("B27").Value = staffID
                        ws.Range("B27").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                        ws.Range("C27").Value = staffData(0)
                        ws.Range("D27").Value = staffData(1)
                        
                    Case 28
                        ws.Range("B29").Value = staffID
                        ws.Range("B29").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                        ws.Range("C29").Value = staffData(0)
                        ws.Range("D29").Value = staffData(1)
                        
                    'Case 29
                        'ws.Range("B31").Value = staffID
                        'ws.Range("B31").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                        'ws.Range("C31").Value = staffData(0)
                        'ws.Range("D31").Value = staffData(1)
                        
                    'Case 30
                        'ws.Range("B32").Value = staffID
                        'ws.Range("B32").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                        'ws.Range("C32").Value = staffData(0)
                        'ws.Range("D32").Value = staffData(1)
                        
                    Case 19   'runner
                        ws.Range("G18").Value = staffID
                        ws.Range("G18").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                        ws.Range("H18").Value = staffData(0)
                        ws.Range("I18").Value = staffData(1)
                        
                    Case 18  'cooking
                        ws.Range("G17").Value = staffID
                        ws.Range("G17").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                        ws.Range("H17").Value = staffData(0)
                        ws.Range("I17").Value = staffData(1)
                        
                    Case 17  'dressing
                        ws.Range("G16").Value = staffID
                        ws.Range("G16").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                        ws.Range("H16").Value = staffData(0)
                        ws.Range("I16").Value = staffData(1)
                        
                    Case 14  'protein
                        Select Case staffCount
                            Case 0
                                ws.Range("G4").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("G4").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("H4").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("I4").Value = staffData(1)
                            Case 1
                                ws.Range("G5").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("G5").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("H5").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("I5").Value = staffData(1)
                        End Select
                        
                    Case 15  'vege
                        Select Case staffCount
                            Case 0
                                ws.Range("G6").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("G6").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("H6").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("I6").Value = staffData(1)
                            Case 1
                                ws.Range("G7").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("G7").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("H7").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("I7").Value = staffData(1)
                        End Select
                        
                    Case 16  'assembly
                        If staffCount < 5 Then
                            ws.Range("G" & (9 + staffCount)).Value = staffID
                            ws.Range("G" & (9 + staffCount)).Interior.Color = sourceColor
                            ws.Range("H" & (9 + staffCount)).Value = staffData(0)
                            ws.Range("I" & (9 + staffCount)).Value = staffData(1)
                        End If
                        
                    Case 4   'SPML-AM
                        If staffCount < 3 Then
                            ws.Range("B" & (10 + staffCount)).Value = staffID
                            ws.Range("B" & (10 + staffCount)).Interior.Color = sourceColor
                            ws.Range("C" & (10 + staffCount)).Value = staffData(0)
                            ws.Range("D" & (10 + staffCount)).Value = staffData(1)
                        End If
                        
                    Case 6   'VA
                        Select Case staffCount
                            Case 0
                                ws.Range("B19").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("B19").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("C19").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("D19").Value = staffData(1)
                            Case 1
                                ws.Range("B20").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("B20").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("C20").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("D20").Value = staffData(1)
                        End Select
                        
                    Case 7  ' Cheese
                        ws.Range("B22").Value = staffID
                        ws.Range("B22").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                        ws.Range("C22").Value = staffData(0)
                        ws.Range("D22").Value = staffData(1)
                        
                    Case 8 'Garnish
                        ws.Range("B23").Value = staffID
                        ws.Range("B23").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                        ws.Range("C23").Value = staffData(0)
                        ws.Range("D23").Value = staffData(1)
                        
                    Case 3 'Garlic Bread
                        ws.Range("B5").Value = staffID
                        ws.Range("B5").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                        ws.Range("C5").Value = staffData(0)
                        ws.Range("D5").Value = staffData(1)
                        
                    Case 5  'SW-AM
                        If staffCount < 3 Then
                            ws.Range("B" & (15 + staffCount)).Value = staffID
                            ws.Range("B" & (15 + staffCount)).Interior.Color = sourceColor
                            ws.Range("C" & (15 + staffCount)).Value = staffData(0)
                            ws.Range("D" & (15 + staffCount)).Value = staffData(1)
                        End If
                        
                    'Case 12 'IDS
                        'ws.Range("B39").Value = staffID
                        'ws.Range("B39").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                        'ws.Range("C39").Value = staffData(0)
                        'ws.Range("D39").Value = staffData(1)
                        
                    Case 2
                        ws.Range("B7").Value = staffID
                        ws.Range("B7").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                        ws.Range("C7").Value = staffData(0)
                        ws.Range("D7").Value = staffData(1)
                        
                    Case 1
                        'only have 2 people
                        Select Case staffDict.Count
                            Case 1
                                ws.Range("B3").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("B3").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("C3").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("D3").Value = staffData(1)
                            Case 2
                                Select Case staffCount
                                    Case 0
                                        ws.Range("B3").Value = staffID
                                        ws.Range("B3").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                        ws.Range("C3").Value = staffData(0)
                                        ws.Range("D3").Value = staffData(1)
                                    Case 1
                                        ws.Range("G3").Value = staffID
                                        ws.Range("G3").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                        ws.Range("H4").Value = staffData(0)
                                        ws.Range("I4").Value = staffData(1)

                                End Select
                        End Select
                        
                    Case 9
                        Select Case staffCount
                            Case 0
                                ws.Range("B6").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("B6").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("C6").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("D6").Value = staffData(1)
                            Case 1
                                ws.Range("B25").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("B25").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("C25").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("D25").Value = staffData(1)
                        End Select
                        
                    Case 20    'Fruit
                        If staffCount < 5 Then
                            ws.Range("G" & (21 + staffCount)).Value = staffID
                            ws.Range("G" & (21 + staffCount)).Interior.Color = sourceColor
                            ws.Range("H" & (21 + staffCount)).Value = staffData(0)
                            ws.Range("I" & (21 + staffCount)).Value = staffData(1)
                        End If
                        
                    Case 10  ' Admin-AM
                        Select Case staffCount
                            Case 0
                                ws.Range("B32").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("B32").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("C32").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("D32").Value = staffData(1)
                            Case 1
                                ws.Range("B33").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("B33").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("C33").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("D33").Value = staffData(1)
                        End Select
                        
                    Case 13   'lettuce check
                        Select Case staffCount
                            Case 0
                                ws.Range("G27").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("G27").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("H27").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("I27").Value = staffData(1)
                            Case 1
                                ws.Range("G28").Value = staffID
                                ws.Range("G28").Interior.Color = sourceColor
                                ws.Range("H28").Value = staffData(0)
                                ws.Range("I28").Value = staffData(1)
                        End Select
                End Select
                
                staffCount = staffCount + 1
            Next staffID
        End If
    Next taskID
    
    ' handle unassigned staff
    If amResults.Exists("100") Then
        ' add title
        ws.Range("H29").Value = "Unassigned Staff"
        ws.Range("H29").Interior.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)  ' red background
        
        ' get dict of unassigned staff
        Set staffDict = amResults("100")
        staffCount = 0
        
        ' loop the staff in the dict
        For Each staffID In staffDict.Keys
            ' split the data
            staffData = Split(staffDict(staffID), "|")
            
            ' set the color to staff
            If staffData(2) = "1" Then
                sourceColor = RGB(217, 217, 217)  ' Roster
            Else
                sourceColor = RGB(255, 242, 204)  ' BCR
            End If
            
            ' section of unassigned staff
            ws.Range("G" & (30 + staffCount)).Value = staffID
            ws.Range("G" & (30 + staffCount)).Interior.Color = sourceColor
            ws.Range("H" & (30 + staffCount)).Value = staffData(0)  ' name
            ws.Range("I" & (30 + staffCount)).Value = staffData(1)  ' time
            
            staffCount = staffCount + 1
        Next staffID
    End If
    
    On Error GoTo 0  ' close the error handler
End Sub

Sub WriteSpecialStatus(ws As Worksheet)
    Dim staffID As Variant
    Dim staffData As Variant
    Dim sourceColor As Long
    Dim row As Long
    
    ' handle AL and RDO special case
    row = 43
    
    ' write in AL
    For Each staffID In AL.Keys
        staffData = Split(AL(staffID), "|")
        sourceColor = IIf(staffData(2) = "1", RGB(217, 217, 217), RGB(255, 242, 204))
        
        ws.Range("G" & row).Value = staffID
        ws.Range("G" & row).Interior.Color = sourceColor
        ws.Range("H" & row).Value = staffData(0)
        ws.Range("H" & row).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)  ' set white background
        ws.Range("I" & row).Value = "AL"
        ws.Range("I" & row).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)  ' set white background
        row = row + 1
    Next staffID
    
    ' write in RDO
    For Each staffID In RDO.Keys
        staffData = Split(RDO(staffID), "|")
        sourceColor = IIf(staffData(2) = "1", RGB(217, 217, 217), RGB(255, 242, 204))
        
        ws.Range("G" & row).Value = staffID
        ws.Range("G" & row).Interior.Color = sourceColor
        ws.Range("H" & row).Value = staffData(0)
        ws.Range("H" & row).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)  ' set white background
        ws.Range("I" & row).Value = "RDO"
        ws.Range("I" & row).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)  ' set white background
        
        row = row + 1
    Next staffID
    
    ' write in WC
    row = 43
    For Each staffID In WC.Keys
        staffData = Split(WC(staffID), "|")
        sourceColor = IIf(staffData(2) = "1", RGB(217, 217, 217), RGB(255, 242, 204))
        
        ws.Range("L" & row).Value = staffID
        ws.Range("L" & row).Interior.Color = sourceColor
        ws.Range("M" & row).Value = staffData(0)
        ws.Range("M" & row).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)  ' set white background
        ws.Range("N" & row).Value = staffData(1)
        ws.Range("N" & row).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)  ' set white background
        row = row + 1
    Next staffID
End Sub

Sub ExecuteAllTasksFour()
    ' set the worksheet
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim amResults As Object
    Dim pmResults As Object
    
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Thursday")
    
'    ' clear all contents
'    Application.ScreenUpdating = False  ' screen updating turned off
    
    ' initialising data
    Call ProcessSchedule
    
    ' get AM assignments results and write in the working sheet
    Set amResults = TestAssignAMTasks
    Call WriteAMAssignments(ws, amResults)
    
    ' get PM assignments results and write in the working sheet
    Set pmResults = TestAssignPMTasks
    Call WritePMAssignments(ws, pmResults)
    
    ' write in the special status staff
    Call WriteSpecialStatus(ws)
    
'    Application.ScreenUpdating = True   ' restore the screen updating
    
    MsgBox "All tasks completed successfully!", vbInformation
End Sub

Sub ResetSheetFour()
    ' variants claim
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim response As VbMsgBoxResult
    
    ' yes or no msgbox
    response = MsgBox("Are you sure you want to reset the sheet?", _
                     vbQuestion + vbYesNo, _
                     "Reset Confirmation")
    
    ' if no exit sub
    If response = vbNo Then
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' if yes continue to reset
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Thursday")
    
    ' BGL needs to clear the contents and change to white background
    With ws.Range("B3:B42")
        .ClearContents
        .Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End With
    
    With ws.Range("G3:G42")
        .ClearContents
        .Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End With
    
    With ws.Range("L3:L42")
        .ClearContents
        .Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End With
    
    With ws.Range("H3:H42")
        .ClearContents
        .Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End With
    With ws.Range("M3:M42")
        .ClearContents
        .Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End With
    
    With ws.Range("H43:H55")
        .ClearContents
        .Interior.Color = RGB(217, 217, 217)
    End With
    
    With ws.Range("I43:I55")
        .ClearContents
        .Interior.Color = RGB(217, 217, 217)
    End With
    
    With ws.Range("M43:M55")
        .ClearContents
        .Interior.Color = RGB(217, 217, 217)
    End With
    
    With ws.Range("N43:N55")
        .ClearContents
        .Interior.Color = RGB(217, 217, 217)
    End With
    
    
    ' others contents clean only
    ws.Range("C3:C42").ClearContents
    ws.Range("D3:D42").ClearContents
    ws.Range("H3:H42").ClearContents
    ws.Range("I3:I42").ClearContents
    ws.Range("M3:M42").ClearContents
    ws.Range("N3:N42").ClearContents
    ws.Range("G43:G55").ClearContents
    ws.Range("L43:L55").ClearContents
    
    MsgBox "Reset completed!", vbInformation
End Sub
